rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality day-5 expanded/hatching blastocyst consistent with 4AA, with appropriate comments on ICM, TE, and zona herniation; minor uncertainty between stage 4 vs 5 prevents a perfect score.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, BMI, unexplained infertility, first-cycle status, endometrial thickness, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, and the probability estimate is supported by the discussed factors; slight overinterpretation of image-stage nuance keeps it from perfect.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with Gardner grading, SET preference, and standard IVF practice; minor speculative points (e.g., selective comments on PGT-A indications) are somewhat simplified.
Provides clear practical recommendations for proceeding with transfer, luteal support, lifestyle measures, and structured next-step planning if unsuccessful.
